queries: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM inv) SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(inv.ratio) - MAX(o.overall) AS ratio_excess FROM inv CROSS JOIN o WHERE inv.ratio > o.overall

WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT AVG(i.avg_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(i.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS ratio_excess_over_overall FROM inv i CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE i.ratio > o.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: Lines with a zero product_price have an undefined ratio and are treated as missing (NULLIF), rather than causing an error.
The overall average ratio is the unweighted mean of per-invoice ratios, and invoices with no computable ratio are excluded from it and from the kept set.

responses.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT AVG(i.avg_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(i.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS ratio_excess_over_overall FROM inv i CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE i.ratio > o.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: Lines with a zero product_price have an undefined ratio and are treated as missing (ignored), via NULLIF, instead of causing an error.

The overall average ratio is the unweighted mean of per-invoice ratios, over invoices that have at least one computable ratio. The final averages are unweighted means of invoice-level values, not weighted by line count.

responses.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM inv) SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(inv.ratio - o.overall) AS ratio_excess_over_overall FROM inv CROSS JOIN o WHERE inv.ratio > o.overall

assumptions.assumption: A line with product_price of 0 has an undefined ratio and is treated as missing (NULLIF), so it is ignored in the ratio average rather than causing an error.
The overall average ratio is the unweighted mean of per-invoice ratios, and invoices with no computable ratio are excluded from that mean and cannot be kept.
